title: HAALAND 2.0
subtitle: 111 GOALS. NO FEELINGS.
description: A tribute to the internet's favourite Terminator — the robot Haaland who scored 111 Premier League goals in 111 games, with a system UI that says FEELINGS: 0. Cute, not cool.
style: 呆萌卡通机器人质感，曼城浅蓝色金属装甲，复古漫画描边，轻松幽默的收藏卡插画，柔和棚拍光，细节清晰
prompt: 哈兰德半机器人：金发丸子头、宽脸高颧骨、曼城浅蓝装甲、怀抱足球
subject_desc: 哈兰德本尊半机器人化：标志性金发丸子头保留（机器人头部，金色发丝清晰可见），宽脸高颧骨、淡到几乎隐形的眉毛、面无表情，上半身穿着曼城浅蓝色机械装甲（胸口白色数字 9），下半身是银色机械腿，双手怀抱一颗黑白足球，卡通 3D 渲染质感，人物居中占画面 65%，四周均匀留白，柔和棚拍光，画面中绝对不出现任何文字、字母、数字（胸前 9 除外）、标志、铭牌、水印，绝对不出现其他人物，呆萌机器人卡通风
background_desc: 未来工厂传送带车间，浅蓝与白色调，传送带上一颗颗足球滚过，背景有巨大的圆形系统屏幕（只显示图案光效，不显示任何文字），画面下方 40% 区域保持简洁的浅色车间地面，背景中绝对不出现任何人物、文字、字母、标志、水印，纯环境空镜
author: HoloLab Studio
honors: 111 Premier League goals in 111 games — the record-breaking Terminator
Robot antenna instead of the iconic golden bun
Fans: 'Haaland is not human' — and he never denied it
back_story: They called him the Terminator. The numbers back it up — 111 Premier League goals in his first 111 games, breaking Alan Shearer's record in record time. The celebrations never showed much emotion: no sprinting, no roaring, just a quiet lotus-pose sit on the grass like a machine shutting down after a job well done. The internet ran with it: 'Haaland is not human', 'He was sent back from 2077 to rewrite football history'. And the best part? He never argued. Cute, not cool — that's the whole joke.

curation.en: Opening of the Haaland Multiverse: 111 goals, zero feelings — the robot meme, cute not cool.
